blocks.text: Group 16 ke elements Chalcogens kehlate hain kyun ke copper (Greek mein chalkos) ki zyada tar ores (khaam dhaat) oxides ya sulfides hoti hain. Is group mein oxygen, sulfur aur selenium (Se) non-metals hain, tellurium (Te) metalloid hai, aur polonium (Po) aur livermorium (Lv) metals hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Se, Te aur Po teeno ko metalloids kehti hai. Sirf tellurium bila shak metalloid (metal aur non-metal ke beech wala element) hai. Selenium aam taur par non-metal mana jata hai aur polonium metal (kuch tables polonium ko metalloid bhi likhti hain).
